title: Added support for typed license keys ([TRIAL], [FREE], [SUB], [PERP]): per-type console messaging around expiration, a corner Handsontable badge with a status tooltip (also shown for missing, invalid, non-commercial, and expired legacy keys), a blocking screen after the trial grace period, and a closable expiration screen for internal-use subscription licenses. Also fixed an 18.0.0 regression where browser builds did not report expired 25-character license keys - keys whose support period ended before the release date show their expiration notices again.
